text:
Maya: heads-up — TrustBridge trial cohort asked for a 90m hands-on office hour next Wed. want to cover onboarding checklist, live API walkthrough, and a short perf/quantization demo. can we lock a time?
Liam: i can do 09:30–11:00 PT or 16:00–17:30 PT. which timezone does their PO prefer?
Maya: they said EMEA-friendly times last week, but will confirm. leaning to the later window to catch both na + eu.
Priya: +1 for later. also flagging renewal risk — they hit a latency regression in staging last night. should we add a 10m Q&A on perf risk and next-step plan?
Maya: yes please — include perf triage and mitigation checklist. want to make sure SEs present fallback routing + model pinning options.
Ravi: i can run the quant demo and show nvbench numbers + a tiny code snippet for their engineers. will prep a short chart/slide.
Ravi: code snippet i'll demo:
```
# show simple per-token latency check
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
print(cli.latency_check(model="gpt-4o-redwood", seq_len=128, batch=1))
```
Liam: put a poll in the thread? doodle works but i'd rather use quick Google form. created two options: https://forms.gle/xYzExample (pick 1).
Maya: thanks — @Liam can you also send a calendar invite with the zoom + dialins once the slot is chosen. include "prework" section: API key, sample prompt, 2 failing test cases.
Priya: also add an action item for CSM to capture their feature adoption signals — they were using embeddings but haven't tried streaming. want to surface that during the session.
Ravi: RSVP: i'll cover quant + a tiny KV cache demo. letting ops know we might need an extra GPU for the live run.
OpsBot: calendar invite created for 2025-11-12 16:00 PT (tentative) — attendees: Maya, Liam, Priya, Ravi, TrustBridge engineers. Invite link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Maya: perfect. I'll draft an email with agenda + prework after we confirm final time. tagging this as prep: cs-prework checklist + perf-runbook. :thumbsup:
Liam: will follow up after form results and finalize invite time.
Priya: noted for renewal playbook — will queue a follow-up health check 2 weeks post-session.
Maya: closing loop — final time by EOD tomorrow pls. thanks everyone!
